WHAT WE DO

Stronger. Safer.
Healthier.

Mycelium, the root network of mushrooms, digests organic matter and weaves itself into a dense web. Mycogen turns that natural binding and fermenting power into standardized cultivation — producing mats for leather-alternative textiles, fire-safe building materials and protein food ingredients.

Mycelium Mats

The starting point of leather alternatives: uniform greige mats for finishing partners.

Fire-safe Building Material

Spent mushroom substrate and pumice, bound by mycelium into a fire-resistant interior panel.

Mycelium Meat Alternative

Korean soybeans fermented with Phellinus or reishi mycelium into a chewy protein ingredient.

Mycelium Egg Powder

Reishi-fermented soybeans and goat-milk whey in a powder that works like egg.

CIRCULAR BY DESIGN

We start with what is thrown away
and make what is needed.

Spent substrate left after mushroom harvests and locally grown beans and grains become food for mycelium. We design for circular inputs, safe processes and healthier food.

CircularSafeHealthy

HOW IT WORKS

How our mycelium platform works

Different products, one starting point: healthy strains, well-designed substrates and strict aseptic control.

  1. 01

    Select the strain

    We select edible and medicinal mushroom strains such as reishi and Phellinus for each use and manage them through a three-stage seed system.

  2. 02

    Design the substrate

    We design the substrate and moisture for each product: spent substrate and pumice, or beans and grains.

  3. 03

    Sterilize & inoculate

    After autoclave sterilization, seed culture is spread evenly through the substrate under aseptic conditions.

  4. 04

    Grow & bind

    Temperature, humidity and CO₂ are controlled so the mycelium knits the whole substrate together.

  5. 05

    Harvest & finish

    Mats ship as greige material, building panels are formed and dried, food is dried at low temperature and milled.
